description.value:
You were once someone of real significance in a noble court or a sprawling bureaucracy — not always by birth, but by talent, favor-trading, and knowing exactly who to flatter. Whether you served the upper echelons of a capital world or navigated the cutthroat backrooms of a lawless trade hub, you learned how institutions actually work.

You may no longer hold your old post, but your former colleagues still remember you, and you still know how to find whoever really runs a place.

system.equipment: A set of fine clothes and a pouch containing 150 credits.
